<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Book Metro Ticket">ba90939793eac710f6a4fcf08bba10af</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:1b93d71f93eac710f6a4fcf08bba1034</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Test Source Station Distance</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {

    if (isLoading || newValue == '') {
        return;
    }

    g_form.getReference('source_station', function(station) {

        if (!station) {
            alert('Could not retrieve the station record.');
            return;
        }

        var distance = station.getValue('distance_from_origin');

        alert(
            'Station: ' + station.getValue('station_name') +
            '\nDistance From Origin: ' + distance
        );
    });
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-12 19:54:01</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>930a28eb93a60b10f6a4fcf08bba1008</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Test Source Station Distance</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Metro Ticket Generating System" source="x_2034419_metro_0">a345a91393928b10f6a4fcf08bba109b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Metro Ticket Generating System">a345a91393928b10f6a4fcf08bba109b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_930a28eb93a60b10f6a4fcf08bba1008</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-12 19:54:01</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>0</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
